name: Calibration: average text CV
notes: v1.1 calibration set. A mid-level developer: a couple of metrics, two weak openers, no phone or LinkedIn. Should land in the C/B band — general mode weighs format (ATS, structure) heavily, so a tidy CV with weak content still reaches B-.
